updateLogZh: 改为完整游戏更新包，不再依赖旧版游戏文件
完整包含第零章、第一章与第二章关卡和战斗音乐
修复可选游戏更新按钮点击无效与游戏文件不完整问题
鼠标视差仅作用于背景并采用整数像素，降低模糊与拖影掉帧感
updateLogEn: Switched to a complete game package without depending on an older installation.
Included all Chapter 0, Chapter 1, and Chapter 2 operation and battle music.
Fixed optional update actions and incomplete game installations.
Limited mouse parallax to integer-positioned backgrounds to reduce blur and perceived frame drops.
